review.decision: Keep live Data T unresolved; do not run tmutil localsnapshot.
rationale: The installed tmutil manual describes local snapshots for APFS volumes included in a Time Machine backup; this command does not select Data explicitly.
No Time Machine destination is configured, and command availability does not prove Data inclusion or supported creation on this host.
Apple documents local snapshot dependence on Time Machine settings and retention under time/space pressure.
The current 44 GiB free space has no qualified capture-churn or OS-headroom budget.
A snapshot could be pruned before complete descriptor-bound capture and Kingston readback; K is a separate gate.
future_reconsideration_requires: A separately qualified supported Time Machine destination/configuration that does not introduce unrelated writes to the sole Kingston custody copy.
Pinned proof that Data is included and exact Data snapshot identity before and after creation.
A measured conservative free-space floor, bounded retention, and reviewed writer stop/resume procedure.
Exact read-only snapshot mount attestation and complete capture/readback before retention ends.

limitations: This receipt records current-host command/configuration observations and Sol's bounded decision only.
It does not establish whether a separately configured Time Machine setup could qualify Data T.
No source capture, positive full restore, owner/protected closure, or erase readiness is established.
